headlines.headline: Lakers' record $12.5B sale awaits league vote as season opens Tuesday
headlines.detail: The agreed sale of the Lakers to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for a record $12.5 billion, topping last year's $10B Buss-to-Walter deal, still needs NBA Board of Governors approval next month, even as the 2026-27 season tips off Tuesday with a three-game opening slate led by Celtics at Pistons.

headlines.headline: Commanders at 49ers headline MNF as trade frenzy rolls on
headlines.detail: San Francisco (5-0) hosts Washington (1-3-1) tonight on Monday Night Football, kickoff 8:15 PM ET/6:15 PM MT. The game is still to be played; it caps a week in which J.J. McCarthy, Joey Porter Jr. and Cam Jurgens all switched teams ahead of the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

headlines.headline: Week 7's upsets reshape the playoff picture heading into Week 8
headlines.detail: Saturday's chaos, BYU's 28-24 stunner over Notre Dame, Ohio State's shaky 19-15 escape past Indiana (losing QB Julian Sayin to injury), Florida's comeback past Texas, and Tennessee's rout of Alabama, has scrambled the committee picture with the AP's updated Top 25 still digesting the results.

headlines.headline: AP preseason Top 25 looms as Florida, Duke headline No. 1 race
headlines.detail: With the men's regular season tipping off Nov. 2, the AP's preseason Top 25 is expected any day. Florida was tabbed No. 1 in the SEC's preseason media poll and is widely projected as Duke's closest rival for the national top spot; the two meet Dec. 1 in Gainesville as part of the ACC/SEC Challenge.
